title: Agent Usage Detail Record (AUDR)
description: This specification defines the Agent Usage Detail Record (AUDR), a JSON object that describes one metered operation in an agent system. A record identifies its emitter and resource, reports raw model or tool usage, associates the operation with a run, and carries attribution required for downstream cost allocation. A record MAY include an informational cost assertion.

spec_version.description: AUDR schema version, constrained here to 1.0.x. Consumers MUST reject unsupported major versions.
spec_version.x_summary: AUDR schema version, constrained here to 1.0.x. Consumers MUST reject unsupported major versions.

record_id.description: ULID or UUIDv7 idempotency key, unique to each emitted record rather than each logical event. Records from different components use distinct IDs and are merged, not deduplicated.
record_id.x_summary: ULID or UUIDv7 idempotency key, unique to each emitted record rather than each logical event. Records from different components use distinct IDs and are merged, not deduplicated.

emitter.description: Identifies the software component that wrote the record.

component.description: Component that wrote the record. This field identifies the caller that metered tool usage and cost.
component.x_summary: Component that wrote the record. This field identifies the caller that metered tool usage and cost.

version.description: Emitter release used to attribute data-quality issues.
version.x_summary: Emitter release used to attribute data-quality issues.

emitter.x_summary: Identifies the software component that wrote the record.

corrects.description: Identifies one earlier record fully restated by this correction. The correction MUST contain full state, use a fresh record_id, and come from the same emitter.component; all-zero usage represents a void.
corrects.x_summary: Identifies one earlier record fully restated by this correction. The correction MUST contain full state, use a fresh record_id, and come from the same emitter.component; all-zero usage represents a void.

timing.description: Event completion, ingest, and duration observations.

event_time.description: Event invocation time in RFC 3339 format with millisecond precision; for streams, use stream termination.
event_time.x_summary: Event invocation time in [RFC 3339](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339) format with millisecond precision; for streams, use stream termination.

received_time.description: Ingest time in RFC 3339 format with millisecond precision. Set by the sink.
received_time.x_summary: Ingest time in [RFC 3339](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339) format with millisecond precision. Set by the sink.

timing.x_summary: Event completion, ingest, and duration observations.

resource.description: Identifies the consumed model or tool. Model operations require type=model; tool_execution and retrieval require type=tool.
resource.x_summary: Identifies the consumed model or tool. Model operations require type=model; tool_execution and retrieval require type=tool.

provider.description: Canonical lowercase provider slug. For tool operations, identify the executing vendor or platform; use self-hosted for locally run tools.
provider.x_summary: Canonical lowercase provider slug. For tool operations, identify the executing vendor or platform; use self-hosted for locally run tools.

type.description: Named resource kind: model for model operations or tool for tool_execution and retrieval. resource.operation selects the usage block.
type.x_summary: Named resource kind: model for model operations or tool for tool_execution and retrieval. resource.operation selects the usage block.

name.description: Verbatim provider model identifier for models, or stable logical tool/backend identifier for tools. Do not normalize model names or use URLs and versioned function symbols for tools.
name.x_summary: Verbatim provider model identifier for models, or stable logical tool/backend identifier for tools. Do not normalize model names or use URLs and versioned function symbols for tools.

operation.description: Operation class that selects resource.type and usage: model operations use model with usage.llm; tool_execution and retrieval use tool with usage.tool.
operation.x_summary: Operation class that selects resource.type and usage: model operations use model with usage.llm; tool_execution and retrieval use tool with usage.tool.

modality.description: The modality of the task or operation. This field is required when resource.type is model.

key_name.description: Credential label from the gateway registry. It MUST contain no key material, prefix, hash, or other secret substring.
key_name.x_summary: Credential label from the gateway registry. It MUST contain no key material, prefix, hash, or other secret substring.

region.description: Region affecting price and data residency.
region.x_summary: Region affecting price and data residency.

deployment.description: Open-vocabulary deployment platform or environment, such as AWS, GCP, Azure, or self-hosted.

run.description: Groups metered operations into a task and span hierarchy. Spawned agents reuse run_id, parent_span_id links within that run, and a harness outcome closes the run.
run.x_summary: Groups metered operations into a task and span hierarchy. Spawned agents reuse run_id, parent_span_id links within that run, and a harness outcome closes the run.

run_id.description: Unique run identifier, generated by the harness or by the router when no harness exists. It MUST be account-unique and identical on every record in the run, including spawned-agent records.
run_id.x_summary: Unique run identifier, generated by the harness or by the router when no harness exists. It MUST be account-unique and identical on every record in the run, including spawned-agent records.

name.description: Optional human-readable name of the agentic run. When absent, run_id is used in its place for display purposes.
name.x_summary: Optional human-readable name of the agentic run. When absent, run_id is used in its place for display purposes.

span_id.description: Span identifier for one metered operation, unique within run_id. Together they form the sink merge key, which MUST NOT be shared by different operations.
span_id.x_summary: Span identifier for one metered operation, unique within run_id. Together they form the sink merge key, which MUST NOT be shared by different operations.

parent_span_id.description: Links nested tools and spawned agents to a span in the same run_id. Spawned agents MUST reuse the parent run_id and set this field to their spawning span.
parent_span_id.x_summary: Links nested tools and spawned agents to a span in the same run_id. Spawned agents MUST reuse the parent run_id and set this field to their spawning span.

trace_id.description: W3C trace identifier for OpenTelemetry correlation.
trace_id.x_summary: W3C trace identifier for OpenTelemetry correlation.

error_code.description: Error code when the run fails. Report consumed usage even on failure; downstream rating decides billability.
error_code.x_summary: Error code when the run fails. Report consumed usage even on failure; downstream rating decides billability.

error_reason.description: Human-readable message of the run failure, limited to 32 characters.
error_reason.x_summary: Human-readable message of the run failure, limited to 32 characters.

outcome.description: The agent run's final outcome, emitted only by the harness.
outcome.x_summary: The agent run's final outcome, emitted only by the harness.

attribution.description: Carries billability and allocation dimensions. Emitters MUST supply environment; sinks ignore records missing it, and production records require account_id.
attribution.x_summary: Carries billability and allocation dimensions. Emitters MUST supply environment; sinks ignore records missing it, and production records require account_id.

environment.description: Deployment environment. A conformant emitter MUST populate it; a missing value triggers default-deny ignore.
environment.x_summary: Deployment environment. A conformant emitter MUST populate it; a missing value triggers default-deny ignore.

user_id.description: Pseudonymous identity of the triggering user; never an email or name. It MUST NOT be used by rating; account_id MUST be used for rating.
user_id.x_summary: Pseudonymous identity of the triggering user; never an email or name. It MUST NOT be used by rating; account_id MUST be used for rating.

account_id.description: The account that pays the bill. Rating may aggregate usage by this account. Required for production traffic; optional otherwise.
account_id.x_summary: The account that pays the bill. Rating may aggregate usage by this account. Required for production traffic; optional otherwise.

subscription_id.description: Subscription associated with the paying account for this usage record.
subscription_id.x_summary: Subscription associated with the paying account for this usage record.

labels.description: Up to 20 free-form dimensions for non-billable metadata. Labels MUST NOT contain PII.
labels.x_summary: Up to 20 free-form dimensions for non-billable metadata. Labels MUST NOT contain PII.

allOf.$comment: account_id is required for production traffic.

usage.description: Raw, non-monetary counters with exactly one non-empty llm or tool block selected by resource.operation. An absent counter means unreported or inapplicable; zero means measured as zero and MUST NOT be inferred from absence.
usage.x_summary: Raw, non-monetary counters with exactly one non-empty llm or tool block selected by resource.operation. An absent counter means unreported or inapplicable; zero means measured as zero and MUST NOT be inferred from absence.

llm.description: Non-empty model-call counters. A harness may emit counters read from the provider response.
llm.x_summary: Non-empty model-call counters. A harness may emit counters read from the provider response.

input_tokens.description: Uncached input tokens; MUST exclude cache reads.
input_tokens.x_summary: Uncached input tokens; MUST exclude cache reads.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens; exclude reasoning tokens when reasoning_tokens is present.
output_tokens.x_summary: Output tokens; exclude reasoning tokens when reasoning_tokens is present.

cache_read_tokens.description: Prompt-cache read tokens, reported separately for distinct pricing.
cache_read_tokens.x_summary: Prompt-cache read tokens, reported separately for distinct pricing.

cache_write_tokens.description: Tokens written to a prompt cache by this call.
cache_write_tokens.x_summary: Tokens written to a prompt cache by this call.

reasoning_tokens.description: Reasoning tokens, separate from output for independent pricing.
reasoning_tokens.x_summary: Reasoning tokens, separate from output for independent pricing.

requests.description: Request count for per-request pricing. No default applies: absent means unreported, while one request is encoded as 1.
requests.x_summary: Request count for per-request pricing. No default applies: absent means unreported, while one request is encoded as 1.

tool.description: Non-empty counters reported by the component that executed the tool: harness for caller-held contracts, router for provider-executed tools.
tool.x_summary: Non-empty counters reported by the component that executed the tool: harness for caller-held contracts, router for provider-executed tools.

type.description: The tool operation being metered, such as invocation, api, web_search, code_execution, or retrieval. It complements resource.operation and resource.name.
type.x_summary: The tool operation being metered, such as invocation, api, web_search, code_execution, or retrieval. It complements resource.operation and resource.name.

call_count.description: Invocation or run count used for per-call pricing. For retrieval, this is usually the query count.
call_count.x_summary: Invocation or run count used for per-call pricing. For retrieval, this is usually the query count.

sandbox_time.description: Sandbox compute wall-clock time in milliseconds, distinct from whole-operation timing.duration_ms. Used when an agent run spins up a sandbox for tool execution.
sandbox_time.x_summary: Sandbox compute wall-clock time in milliseconds, distinct from whole-operation timing.duration_ms. Used when an agent run spins up a sandbox for tool execution.

cost.description: Provider- or router-asserted cost that rating MAY use or ignore according to its billing configuration. Components are gross, total_cost is net, and the single cost sub-block must match usage; rating MAY check consistency but MUST NOT overwrite the total.
cost.x_summary: Provider- or router-asserted cost that rating MAY use or ignore according to its billing configuration. Components are gross, total_cost is net, and the single cost sub-block must match usage; rating MAY check consistency but MUST NOT overwrite the total.

currency.description: Currency code of the costs in uppercase according to ISO 4217 format.
currency.x_summary: Currency code of the costs in uppercase according to ISO 4217 format.

llm.description: The gross cost of the model operation calls. The breakdown is similar to usage.llm and is present only for model operations.
llm.x_summary: The gross cost of the model operation calls. The breakdown is similar to usage.llm and is present only for model operations.

total_token_cost.description: Total token cost for this model call event. Reference only and MAY have rounding differences with the sum of individual token costs.
total_token_cost.x_summary: Total token cost for this model call event. Reference only and MAY have rounding differences with the sum of individual token costs.

input_token_cost.description: Cost of uncached input tokens. This would be the total input token cost if cache_read_cost were absent.
input_token_cost.x_summary: Cost of uncached input tokens. This would be the total input token cost if cache_read_cost were absent.

output_token_cost.description: Output token cost and MUST exclude reasoning_cost.
output_token_cost.x_summary: Output token cost and MUST exclude reasoning_cost.

tool.description: The gross cost of the tool execution calls. The breakdown is similar to usage.tool and is present only for tool_execution and retrieval.
tool.x_summary: The gross cost of the tool execution calls. The breakdown is similar to usage.tool and is present only for tool_execution and retrieval.

type.description: The tool operation being metered. It SHOULD match usage.tool.type on the same record.
type.x_summary: The tool operation being metered. It SHOULD match usage.tool.type on the same record.

^x_[a-z0-9_]+$.description: Charge amount for an implementation-specific field named x_<name>.
^x_[a-z0-9_]+$.x_summary: Charge amount for an implementation-specific field named x_<name>.

original_cost.description: List cost before commitments, negotiated rates, or promotions.
original_cost.x_summary: List cost before commitments, negotiated rates, or promotions.

allOf.$comment: MODEL OPERATIONS: resource.type MUST be model, usage.llm is the record's usage block, and the tool sub-blocks MUST be absent.
TOOL OPERATIONS: resource.type MUST be tool, usage.tool is the record's usage block, and the llm sub-blocks MUST be absent.
